text:
Type: reclaimed wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: thick reclaimed wood top with a weathered finish, brushed steel legs
Colors: warm mid brown wood, silver grey steel
Shape: rectangular thick slab top, two open U-shaped sled legs in brushed metal, square edges, low and solid, generous size
Feel: grounded, warm, rugged
Goes with: leather sofas, concrete or grey tones, black or steel accents; industrial or loft living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Culver Reclaimed Industrial Wood Coffee Table, 55.1"W, Natural and Steel
product.description: Sleek, modern stainless steel legs are paired with a reclaimed wood top for a table that will bring rustic and industrial touches to your home. Top it with trays of snacks and beverages for many fun gatherings in the years to come. 55.1"W x 31.5"D x 17.3"H Reclaimed wood and stainless steel Touches of modern, industrial and rustic Sturdy, durable and ideal for displaying magazines or snack trays Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
